magic_signatures.description: Slot 0 header magic u32 0x00224455 (written as local_44=DAT_080b0324 in FUN_080b01a8 via FUN_080b33c0/FUN_080b328c; verified structurally by FUN_080b0350 readback in FUN_08000e00).
Slot 1 header magic u32 0x00224455 (written as local_44=DAT_080b0324 in FUN_080b01a8 via FUN_080b33c0/FUN_080b328c; verified structurally by FUN_080b0350 readback in FUN_08000e00).
Slot 2 header magic u32 0x00224455 (written as local_44=DAT_080b0324 in FUN_080b01a8 via FUN_080b33c0/FUN_080b328c; verified structurally by FUN_080b0350 readback in FUN_08000e00).

fields.name: slot0_checksum
fields.description: Slot 0 header checksum: stored as ~(0x4455 + sum of 144 payload bytes) & 0xFFFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_080b01a8 (080b01a8) computes header word from seed DAT_080b031c + byte-sum of 144 payload bytes at EEPROM addrs 19*slot+1..+18 and writes via FUN_080b33c0/FUN_080b328c; FUN_080b0350 (via FUN_08000e00) re-reads and checks (magic_lo + payload sum + stored)==0xFFFF. Baseline logical bytes: AA BB = 0xBBAA = ~0x4455.

fields.name: slot0_header_pad
fields.description: Slot 0 header pad: upper half of second header u32 word, zero.
fields.evidence: 8-byte header read/written per EEPROM addr (8 bytes) in FUN_080b31dc/FUN_080b328c callers FUN_080b01a8/FUN_080b0350; header u32 word1 = checksum|upper-zero, baseline bytes 00 00.

fields.name: slot0_pickup_bitmap
fields.description: Slot 0 1000-bit collectible bitmap (clear bit = collected); source of FUN_08000d78 remaining-count.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d78 counts clear bits at save struct +0x1c up to DAT_08000dbc; FUN_08000230 memsets struct+0x1c len 0x7d (125B); 1000-total corroborated by ==1000 compare in FUN_080195f0 and (level+1)*100 gating in FUN_0800be04/FUN_0800cda4. Save offset = slotbase+8+(0x1c-0x1c).

fields.name: slot0_cage_bitmap
fields.description: Slot 0 50-bit cage/collectible bitmap (clear bit = collected); source of FUN_08000dc0 counter.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000dc0 counts clear bits over 50 iterations at save struct +0x99 (bytes 0..6); FUN_08000230 memsets struct+0x99 len 7; full-clear == 0x32 tested in FUN_08001a94. Save offset = slotbase+8+(0x99-0x1c).

fields.name: slot0_stage_current
fields.description: Slot 0 current stage/level index snapshot, copied from live index at save time.
fields.evidence: FUN_08081ec0/FUN_0808418c do *(save+0xa0)=*(save+1) immediately before FUN_08000e40(slot); default 0 in FUN_08000230. Save offset = slotbase+8+(0xa0-0x1c).

fields.name: slot0_stage_best
fields.description: Slot 0 highest stage/level index reached (monotonic, capped).
fields.evidence: FUN_08081ec0/FUN_0808418c/FUN_0808cbc0 max-update save+0xa1 against live index with <0x28 cap before FUN_08000e40; default 0 in FUN_08000230.

fields.name: slot0_chances_left
fields.description: Slot 0 remaining-chances counter (default 3), cached per slot at runtime+0x44 on load.
fields.evidence: Default 3 in FUN_08000230; decremented with 0..0x63 clamp in FUN_08076be4-path (line 72970) and FUN_080826c4-path (line 80487) same-layout +0xa2 counters; FUN_08001a94 copies global +0xa2 to per-slot runtime+0x44.

fields.name: slot0_unlock_flags_a
fields.description: Slot 0 level/event unlock flags byte A (bits 0-1 consumed as progress flags on load).
fields.evidence: FUN_08000230 clears all 8 bits of save+0xa3 at init; bits 0-1 tested in FUN_08001a94 (drive runtime+0x85/+0x86); bits 3-6 set in FUN_08090a28 event branches before FUN_08000e40; bit 7 set in FUN_08077484.

fields.name: slot0_unlock_flags_b
fields.description: Slot 0 level/event unlock flags byte B.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000230 clears all 8 bits of save+0xa4 at init; bits 0-1 set/tested in FUN_08077484 same-layout +0xa4 logic.

fields.name: slot0_event_flag_c
fields.description: Slot 0 single-event flag (bit 0, set-once style).
fields.evidence: FUN_08000230 clears bit 0 of save+0xa5 at init; same-offset bit0 set-once/test idiom in FUN_0800cda4 and FUN_08061074.

fields.name: slot0_best_value
fields.description: Slot 0 monotonic best-value byte (max-update from a gameplay counter).
fields.evidence: FUN_08076be4-path max-updates save+0xa6 from gameplay counter before FUN_08000e40; default 0 in FUN_08000230.
